_doc: Cycle budgets for emu/test_cycle_budget.py (emu/cycle_budget.py). rule: abs = budget as written; stock = at most the stock 3.16 value; stock+P% / stock/N relative to it. Stock values are measured by `python3 -m emu.cycle_budget --refresh-stock` (re-run only when the MAME pin or the workloads change). pmoney = the value measured when the budgets were set (payload pmoney_payload_sha256). Rows whose note says 'pinned' hold PMONEY to its measured value + 2 %, because stock would let it regress by 20-50 % unnoticed.

idle_busy_pct.note: busy % of 16 MHz, 120 BPM stopped, nothing loaded (idle and wait loops excluded); pinned at PMONEY + 2 % (stock is the ceiling)

tick_isr_idle.note: tick ISR (vector 09) mean inclusive cycles, stopped

tick_isr_play300.note: tick ISR mean, dense playback 300 BPM, sync off

tick_isr_synca120.note: tick ISR mean, MIDI clock + MTC to OUT A, 120 BPM (so_rt_send detour, R5 residue); PMONEY is +4.0 % over stock here (so_rt_send detour per byte), pinned at PMONEY + 1 %

tick_isr_allon300.note: tick ISR mean, every feature on: clock + MTC to ALL four outputs, mute groups, 300 BPM (stock can send to OUT A only)

tick_body_idle.note: task-2 tick body 422F:0052 mean, stopped (S3 gates)

tick_body_play300.note: task-2 tick body mean, 300 BPM; pinned at PMONEY + 2 % (stock is the ceiling)

tick_body_allon300.note: task-2 tick body mean, every feature on, 300 BPM (stock: OUT A); pinned at PMONEY + 2 % (stock is the ceiling)

isr09_own_max_play300.note: worst tick ISR own cycles (entry to CLI 2C45:085C, nested ISRs removed), 300 BPM; re-pinned 2026-10-17 (universal layout): the 0ae678e build measured 2934.992; the same 0ae678e code with 7,870 zero bytes appended to STARTUP.SYS measures 3150, as the universal build does (3150-3154): the 0.2 s longer floppy load shifts the phase of every later event against the tick, not a code change (notes/port_316.md 'Cave space'); budget = 3154 + 1 %

ifoff_max_us_play.note: worst interrupt-off window (us), playback 120 and 300 BPM, sync off

ifoff_max_us_allon300.note: worst interrupt-off window (us), every feature on (ALL); stock OUT A is the reference

tick_done_max_ms_play120.note: worst tick completion (ISR-09 entry to task-2 return, FIFO), 120 BPM; pinned at PMONEY + 2 % (stock is the ceiling)

tick_done_max_ms_play300.note: worst tick completion, 300 BPM; pinned at PMONEY + 2 % (stock is the ceiling); re-pinned 2026-10-17 (universal layout): the 0ae678e build measured 3.055 ms; the same 0ae678e code with 7,870 zero bytes appended to STARTUP.SYS measures 3.225 ms, as the universal build does (3.225-3.226 ms): the 0.2 s longer floppy load shifts the phase of every later event against the tick, not a code change (notes/port_316.md 'Cave space')

tick_done_max_ms_allon300.note: worst tick completion, every feature on vs stock OUT A; pinned at PMONEY + 2 % (stock is the ceiling)

tx_isr_synca120.note: TX ISR (vector 0C) mean per interrupt, OUT A

note_wrapper_off.note: MIDI note-on, mute groups off: mute_note_on_wrapper (stock: note builder 20ED:000D); mean over a 16-note chord includes RX interrupts that nest in the call: 9,646-9,854 in PMONEY before this pass

note_wrapper_on.note: MIDI note-on, mute groups on: mute_note_on_wrapper; 13,151-13,355 in PMONEY before this pass

pad_lookup.note: pad lookup per MIDI note-on, pads 1-16 (pad_lookup_far; stock 301D:003B)

chord_midi_first_ms.note: 16-note MIDI chord, stopped: first voice set-up, worst of six (R3)

chord_midi_last_ms.note: 16-note MIDI chord, stopped: last voice set-up, worst of six; the last voice moved by up to 1.3 ms between two builds with equal per-note costs (pads 20.2-21.5 ms, MIDI 20.9-21.7 ms; tick phase is the likely cause, HYPOTHESIS), so the budget keeps a fixed margin under stock instead of a 2 % pin

chord_pad_last_ms.note: 16-pad chord: last voice set-up, worst of six; the last voice moved by up to 1.3 ms between two builds with equal per-note costs (pads 20.2-21.5 ms, MIDI 20.9-21.7 ms; tick phase is the likely cause, HYPOTHESIS), so the budget keeps a fixed margin under stock instead of a 2 % pin

int43_wheel.note: INT 43 mean per call, Play/Record wheel (stock handler: S6 is not built)

screen_change.note: busy cycles per screen change above the build's own idle rate; S6 not built. PMONEY +3.7 % over stock by this estimate, but its lower idle rate (S3) inflates it: the tour window's total busy is 9.0 % under stock (24.80 M vs 27.26 M cycles). Pinned at PMONEY + 2 %

pr_redraw.note: Play/Record field redraw 159C8 mean (S6 not built)

view_wheel_full.note: wave view full-mode redraw (refresh + blit), 25 ms target

silence_per_frame.note: Edit Sound Do SILENCE ZONE cycles per frame (DMA-paced guard; PMONEY was 29.3, +2.4 % over stock, before the performance pass)
